title: IconButton
description: A compact button that only shows an icon. With pressed / defaultPressed it becomes a toggle button (favorite, like, mute...).

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Pass any icon element. The button only contains an icon, so always give it an aria-label. It renders a native button with type="button", so it never submits a form.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: color applies a semantic color: neutral (default), primary, success, warning, danger or info.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: variant sets the visual style: ghost (default, transparent until hovered), solid (filled with the color) or outline (bordered).

sizes-and-shapes.title: Sizes and shapes
sizes-and-shapes.description: Three sizes (small, medium, large) and two shapes (circle, square).

states.title: States
states.description: loading replaces the icon with a spinner and keeps the button focusable (aria-busy + aria-disabled) while ignoring activation, pressed marks a toggle as on and disabled sets the native disabled attribute, which removes the button from the tab order.

toggle.title: Toggle button
toggle.description: Set pressed (controlled, with onPressedChange) or defaultPressed (uncontrolled) to make a toggle: clicking flips the state, which is exposed with aria-pressed. Keep the label stable (e.g. "Like"), since the state is announced separately.

search.title: Search button
search.description: A search action is an IconButton with a search icon and a label; with type="submit" it submits its form, and loading blocks it while the search runs. Use a Button when the action needs visible text.

custom-colors.title: Custom colors
custom-colors.description: Override the resolved colors with CSS custom properties: --icon-button-color (icon), --icon-button-hover-bg (hover background), --icon-button-pressed-color and --icon-button-pressed-bg (pressed toggle). Set them inline, in a class or on an ancestor.

tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.description: Set showTooltip and tooltip to describe the action on hover and keyboard focus.

label.title: Label and tooltip
label.description: label names the button and is shown as its tooltip; the icon can be passed as children. variant sets the visual style and color the semantic color.

IconButtonProps.variant: Visual style: ghost (transparent until hovered), solid (filled with the color) or outline (bordered)
IconButtonProps.disabled: Disables the native button and removes it from the tab order
IconButtonProps.loading: Replaces the icon with a spinner and ignores activation (click, Enter, Space, form submission) while staying focusable: exposed as aria-busy + aria-disabled instead of the native disabled attribute
IconButtonProps.pressed: Pressed state of a toggle button (controlled; pair with onPressedChange); exposed as aria-pressed
IconButtonProps.defaultPressed: Initial pressed state of an uncontrolled toggle button
IconButtonProps.onPressedChange: Called with the new pressed state when a toggle button is activated
IconButtonProps.tooltip: Tooltip configuration (content, color, variant, shape, arrow); requires showTooltip
IconButtonProps.showTooltip: Shows the tooltip on hover and focus
IconButtonProps.aria-label: Accessible label; always set it, since the button only contains an icon
IconButtonProps.children: Icon element, alternative to the icon prop
IconButtonProps.label: Accessible name of the button, also shown as its tooltip (unless showTooltip is false). Takes precedence over aria-label

cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-color: Icon color of a pressed toggle
cssVars.--icon-button-size: Width and height of the button (every size; defaults follow the density's control heights)
cssVars.--icon-button-icon-size: Font size of the icon (every size)
cssVars.--icon-button-radius: Corner radius of the square shape (defaults to --radius-lg)
